note: Juneau County park of about 300 acres on the Petenwell Flowage, with a swim beach, boat launches and hiking trails. The shore-road sites along the flowage have room to keep a boat by the site. --Claude
summary: County reservation site read: 127 sites (107 electric; 50 A at 58), 2027 $27 electric + $10 res fee, no reservations Sept 15-Dec 1 (FCFS self-register). 90 of 126 site pages bookable online (rest likely seasonal) - nightly majority. Lakefront kept: northern shore-road sites 108-116 on open grass ~15-30 m from the water. Phone/website confirmed.
flags: WATERFRONT: lakefront kept. The northern half of the shore-road row - sites 108-116 by the county's map and descriptions ('sunny, grassy, and level') - are back-in spurs on open mown grass with the Petenwell Flowage ~15-30 m past the pad ends (~44.1513-44.1527,-89.9857 to -89.9851, Esri zoom 18). All of 108-127 carry 'Book Now' (sold by the night). The southern part of the row (117-120 'shady', ~44.1480-44.1505) sits behind a 30-40 m belt of shore trees - view only. Sites 1-9 ('shady site located near the lake') were not matched site by site on imagery; they don't change the call.

NIGHTLY SHARE: 90 of the 126 site pages carry 'Book Now'; the other 36 (e.g. 1, 3, 10, 78, 80, 81, 83, 103) do not and are presumably the seasonal ones (seasonal $1,110-$1,830 posted). Nightly is the clear majority.

SEASON: none set. The office is open Memorial Day to Labor Day weekend and 'Self Registration allowed for the rest of the year'; camping Sept 15-Dec 1 is first come, first served; nothing states winter camping or a closing date.

COUNTS: the county says 107 electric sites; the site pages list 106 with amps (one site has no page). Pads 35-136 ft; every electric site lists 'Medium Camper' or larger except site 3 ('Tent, Small Camper', 35 ft).

PIN 44.1542,-89.9852 is at the park gate on 21st Avenue; the office/shower buildings are ~150 m east (~44.1544,-89.9834) and the camping spreads 1 km along the shore. Left (gate is a fair arrival point).
PHONE 608-565-7285 confirmed. WEBSITES: both stored links live (co.juneau.wi.gov page returns 200).
